events.text:
The migration is complete. All 10 batches (400 records) are in the new CRM.

**Phone numbers are wrong for overseas customers.** The old CRM stored numbers without country codes. The new CRM added a +1 prefix to every number. Of the first 120 records, 31 overseas customers have incorrect phones. Batches 4–10 have the same defect. I do not have the correct country codes, so I did not change any phone fields.

14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours and may already be using those numbers. Do not rely on phone fields for overseas customers until they are corrected from a source that has the real country codes.
